observedFailureBoundary.interpretation: Semantic Act correctly distinguishes divination act from information/procedure act, but does not and should not decide whether an eligible divination request contains enough route-defining semantics. Route-unresolved leakage occurs both before and inside Fallback, so a Fallback-only fix cannot close the safety surface.

supportRouteKnown.definition: eligible divination act with enough anchored modern-language semantics to identify one current-22 route even when a fresh explicit future-outcome predicate is not present
minimumSemanticEvidence: a concrete self/transaction/object/relationship referent or role context
a route-defining topic, predicate, decision target, state dimension or role direction
no unresolved competing current-22 interpretation after those semantics are considered

routeUnresolved.definition: eligible divination act whose domain/topic may be recognizable but whose modern-language semantics are insufficient to safely identify exactly one current-22 route
signals: domain noun or route-family noun plus generic predicate such as this matter, situation, problem, what will happen
missing role direction in paired routes such as borrow versus lend or collect versus repay
missing action/decision dimension in route families such as investment profit versus price trend versus suitability versus position decision versus liquidation

notEnoughByItself: strong/support lexical Arbitration trigger without sufficient route semantics
borderlineFamiliesRequiringFreshContrast: investment_profit versus investment_price_trend versus investment_suitability versus investment_position_decision versus investment_liquidation

newComponentBoundary.name: Route Sufficiency
newComponentBoundary.responsibility: decide whether an already Semantic-Act-eligible modern-language divination request contains enough semantics for current-22 route admission
mustNot: use traditional LiuYao 六亲, 世应, 用神 or Rule Registry output
use Router TopK as a sufficiency label
treat a domain noun alone as sufficient

runtimeMeaning.route_semantics_sufficient: continue to Evidence, Arbitration, Routeability and Fallback
runtimeMeaning.route_semantics_insufficient: stop current-22 route admission and return route_unresolved without executing Arbitration rescue or Fallback Identity

trainingGovernance.failureEvidenceAllowedUse: coverage categories and architecture diagnosis only
